title: On the Runway Cascade of Transformers for Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2601.14522v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In decoder-only (causal) transformers, the computation graph created by causal masking routes information through both direct-path attention and indirect paths formed by intermediate tokens. We denote these indirect paths between token pairs as their runways. We argue that certain failure modes of causal transformers as observed by a growing body of recent works are likely exacerbated by a misalignment between these two information propagation modes. We formalize runway cascade as a phenomenon whereby this misalignment results in redundancies and irrelevant information cascading to token representations despite adequately learned attention patterns. As a solution, we propose runway-aware rewiring as a more explicit way of incorporating runway context directly into each token's direct-path attention. translated_title: 论语言建模中Transformer的跑道级联
translated_abstract: 在仅解码器（因果）Transformer中，由因果掩码构建的计算图通过直接路径注意力以及由中间标记形成的间接路径来传递信息。我们将标记对之间的这些间接路径称为其“跑道”。我们认为，近期越来越多的研究所观察到的因果Transformer的某些失效模式，很可能被这两种信息传播模式之间的失调所加剧。我们将“跑道级联”形式化为一种现象：尽管注意力模式已被充分学习，这种失调仍会导致冗余和无关信息级联至标记表示中。作为解决方案，我们提出“跑道感知重连”，这是一种将跑道上下文更直接地融入每个标记的直接路径注意力的显式方法。该机制基于每个标记的跑道全景概要来重新连接其注意力模式，使其能够感知累积（后文截断）。
tldr: 提出并形式化“跑道级联”现象，解释因果Transformer中直接路径与间接路径（跑道）之间的信息传播失调如何导致冗余信息污染标记表示，并设计“跑道感知重连”机制来显式缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: Formalizes "runway cascade" to explain how misalignment between direct-path attention and indirect token-mediated paths in causal transformers causes redundant information to pollute token representations, and proposes a runway-aware rewiring mechanism that explicitly mitigates this failure mode.
